versions.changelog:
x402-api-integration v0.1.0

- Initial release of x402 API integration skill.
- Instantly turn any Node.js function into a pay-per-call API endpoint with HTTP-native USDC payments via the x402 protocol.
- Zero dependencies: works with Node 16 standard library only.
- Simple, extensible server template provided — add your own service logic.
- Supports payment enforcement and demo mode; ready for real payment verification with minimal changes.
- Easy deployment instructions for rapid launch (Cloudflare Tunnel or VPS).
